description: An individual carrying two normal function alleles
consultationtext: This result signifies that the patient has two copies of a normal function allele. Patients with this genotype are expected to require higher starting tacrolimus dosing (1.5 times to 2 times the standard dose-maximum starting dose not to exceed 0.3mg/kg/day). Further dose adjustments or selection of alternative therapy may be necessary due to other clinical factors (e.g., medication interactions, or hepatic function). Please consult a clinical pharmacist for more specific dosing information.

Further dose adjustments or selection of alternative therapy may be necessary due to other clinical factors (e.g., medication interactions, or hepatic function). Please consult a clinical pharmacist for more specific dosing information.

description: An individual carrying two no function alleles
consultationtext: This result signifies that the patient has two copies of a no function allele. Patients with this genotype are expected to require standard tacrolimus dosing. Please consult a clinical pharmacist for more specific dosing information.
